cn-20260927-news-3.title: Four high-speed rail lines opened on the same day before National Day: Harbin-Yichang HSR becomes China's northernmost HSR, and the Xiong'an-Shangqiu section of the Beijing-Hong Kong HSR has a total length of 552 kilometers

segments.src: 9月28日，京港高铁雄安至商丘段、西渝高铁西安至安康段、宜昌至兴山高铁、哈尔滨至伊春高铁四条新线集中开通运营。四条线路分别位于华北、西北、华中和东北，将进一步织密“八纵八横”高速铁路网，为沿线居民的日常出行和国庆假期出行提供更多选择。
segments.tr: On September 28, four new railway lines were simultaneously put into operation: the Xiong'an-Shangqiu section of the Beijing-Hong Kong HSR, the Xi'an-Ankang section of the Xi'an-Chongqing HSR, the Yichang-Xingshan HSR, and the Harbin-Yichang HSR. Located in North China, Northwest China, Central China, and Northeast China respectively, these four lines will further weave the "eight vertical and eight horizontal" high-speed railway network denser, providing more choices for the daily travel of residents along the routes and their travel during the National Day holiday.

segments.tr: The total mileage of the four new lines is about 1,142 kilometers. The above data comes from the information released by the railway department, and the specific train operation schedule is subject to the release by the railway department.

segments.src: ## 京港高铁雄商段：全长552公里的南北新通道
segments.tr: ## Beijing-Hong Kong HSR Xiong-Shang Section: A New North-South Passage with a Total Length of 552 Kilometers

segments.src: 京港高铁是“八纵八横”高铁网中的一“纵”，规划由北京经雄安、商丘、合肥、南昌等地通往香港。此次开通的雄商段北起雄安站，途经河北的雄安新区、沧州、衡水、邢台，山东的聊城，河南的濮阳，再经山东的济宁、菏泽，最终接入河南的商丘站，正线全长552公里，设计时速350公里。
segments.tr: The Beijing-Hong Kong HSR is one "vertical" in the "eight vertical and eight horizontal" high-speed rail network, planned to run from Beijing via Xiong'an, Shangqiu, Hefei, Nanchang, and other places to Hong Kong. The Xiong-Shang section opened this time starts from Xiong'an Station in the north, passing through Xiong'an New Area, Cangzhou, Hengshui, and Xingtai in Hebei, Liaocheng in Shandong, Puyang in Henan, and then via Jining and Heze in Shandong, finally connecting to Shangqiu Station in Henan. The main line has a total length of 552 kilometers and a designed speed of 350 kilometers per hour.

segments.src: 这一段开通后，雄安站至商丘站最快2小时27分可达。铁路部门还将首次开行由北京西经京雄城际铁路、京港高铁雄商段、商合段等线路前往合肥、黄山北等地的跨线高铁列车。京津冀、黄淮地区与皖南等地之间的高铁联系将更加紧密。
segments.tr: After this section opens, the journey from Xiong'an Station to Shangqiu Station will take as fast as 2 hours and 27 minutes. The railway department will also operate cross-line high-speed trains for the first time from Beijing West via the Beijing-Xiong'an Intercity Railway, the Beijing-Hong Kong HSR Xiong-Shang section, and the Shangqiu-Hefei section to Hefei, Huangshan North, and other places. The high-speed rail connections between the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Huang-Huai region, and southern Anhui will become closer.

segments.src: ## 哈伊高铁：我国最北端的高速铁路
segments.tr: ## Harbin-Yichang HSR: China's Northernmost High-Speed Railway

segments.src: 哈尔滨至伊春高铁（简称哈伊高铁）起自哈尔滨站，途经绥化市、铁力市，终至伊春市，全长318公里，设计时速250公里。据报道，这也是目前我国最北端的高速铁路，伊春西站是我国已建成高铁车站中纬度最高的一座。
segments.tr: The Harbin-Yichang High-Speed Railway (referred to as the Harbin-Yichang HSR) starts from Harbin Station, passes through Suihua City and Tieli City, and ends at Yichang City, with a total length of 318 kilometers and a designed speed of 250 kilometers per hour. According to reports, this is currently China's northernmost high-speed railway, and Yichang West Station is the highest-latitude built high-speed railway station in China.

segments.src: 线路开通后，哈尔滨至伊春最快1小时46分可达。对于以森林旅游、生态资源闻名的小兴安岭地区来说，高铁带来的是更短的通行时间和更稳定的出行方式，也为冰雪、森林等特色旅游资源与外界的往来创造了条件。
segments.tr: After the line opens, the journey from Harbin to Yichang will take as fast as 1 hour and 46 minutes. For the Lesser Khingan Mountains region, which is famous for forest tourism and ecological resources, the high-speed rail brings shorter travel times and a more stable travel mode, and also creates conditions for the external exchanges of special tourism resources such as ice, snow, and forests.

segments.src: ## 西渝高铁西康段：穿行秦岭的西安至安康通道
segments.tr: ## Xi'an-Chongqing HSR Xi'an-Ankang Section: The Xi'an-Ankang Passage Crossing the Qinling Mountains

segments.src: 西渝高铁西安至安康段起自西安东站，途经西安市、商洛市、安康市，接入安康西站，线路全长171公里，设计时速350公里。开通后，西安东站至安康西站最快45分钟可达，陕南与关中之间的往来时间进一步缩短。
segments.tr: The Xi'an-Ankang section of the Xi'an-Chongqing HSR starts from Xi'an East Station, passes through Xi'an City, Shangluo City, and Ankang City, and connects to Ankang West Station. The line has a total length of 171 kilometers and a designed speed of 350 kilometers per hour. After opening, the journey from Xi'an East Station to Ankang West Station will take as fast as 45 minutes, further shortening the travel time between southern Shaanxi and Guanzhong.

segments.src: ## 宜昌至兴山高铁：连接沪渝蓉与郑渝两条通道
segments.tr: ## Yichang-Xingshan HSR: Connecting the Shanghai-Chongqing-Chengdu and Zhengzhou-Chongqing Passages

segments.src: 宜昌至兴山高铁自沪渝蓉高铁宜昌北站引出，经宜昌市夷陵区进入兴山县，接入郑渝高铁兴山站，线路全长101公里，设计时速350公里。开通后，宜昌北站至兴山站最快30分钟可达，鄂西山区与宜昌中心城区的联系更加便捷。
segments.tr: The Yichang-Xingshan HSR branches off from Yichang North Station of the Shanghai-Chongqing-Chengdu HSR, enters Xingshan County via Yiling District of Yichang City, and connects to Xingshan Station of the Zhengzhou-Chongqing HSR. The line has a total length of 101 kilometers and a designed speed of 350 kilometers per hour. After opening, the journey from Yichang North Station to Xingshan Station will take as fast as 30 minutes, making the connection between the mountainous areas of western Hubei and the central urban area of Yichang more convenient.

segments.src: ## 意义：补强路网、缩短时空距离
segments.tr: ## Significance: Strengthening the Railway Network and Shortening Space-Time Distance

segments.src: 从空间分布看，这四条线路覆盖了华北平原、黄淮地区、秦巴山区、鄂西山区和黑龙江小兴安岭地区，既有连接大城市与区域中心的干线通道，也有让山区、林区更便捷融入高铁网络的支线和联络线。新线投入运营后，沿线城市之间的通行时间将进一步压缩，有助于人员往来、物流运输与文旅消费的畅通。
segments.tr: From the perspective of spatial distribution, these four lines cover the North China Plain, the Huang-Huai region, the Qinling-Daba mountainous area, the western Hubei mountainous area, and the Lesser Khingan Mountains area in Heilongjiang. They include trunk passages connecting major cities and regional centers, as well as branch lines and connecting lines that enable mountainous and forest areas to integrate more conveniently into the high-speed rail network. After the new lines are put into operation, the travel time between cities along the routes will be further compressed, which helps smooth personnel exchanges, logistics transportation, and cultural and tourism consumption.

segments.src: ## 出行提示
1. 国庆假期出行人员较多，建议提前通过中国铁路12306官方渠道查询新线车次、时刻和票额信息。
segments.tr: 1. There will be many people traveling during the National Day holiday. It is recommended to check the new line train numbers, schedules, and ticket information in advance through the official channels of China Railway 12306.

segments.src: 2. 新线开通初期，部分车次的停靠站、发车时刻可能随运行图调整而变化，请以铁路部门实时发布的信息为准。
segments.tr: 2. In the early stage of the opening of the new lines, the stopping stations and departure times of some trains may change with the adjustment of the operation schedule. Please refer to the real-time information released by the railway department.

segments.src: 3. 前往东北地区的旅客请留意当地天气和温度变化，适当增添衣物；前往山区的旅客请关注沿线天气预报。
segments.tr: 3. Passengers traveling to the Northeast region should pay attention to local weather and temperature changes and add clothing appropriately; passengers traveling to mountainous areas should pay attention to the weather forecasts along the routes.

segments.src: *信息来源：国家铁路集团有限公司发布的信息及央视新闻、人民网、光明网、新华网等媒体的公开报道。文中数据以铁路部门官方发布为准。*
segments.tr: *Source of information: Information released by China State Railway Group Co., Ltd. and public reports by media such as CCTV News, People's Daily, Guangming Daily, and Xinhua News Agency. The data in the text is subject to the official release of the railway department.*

cn-20260927-news-2.title: Iran Proposes 'Seven-Day Plan' to Reopen Strait of Hormuz, Brent Crude Falls to Around $104, How Will the U.S. Respond?

segments.src: ## 要点速览
- **方案内容**：据伊朗外长表述，伊方已通过卡塔尔向美方转达一项分步方案——美方解除对伊朗港口的封锁，并对伊朗石油出口给予制裁豁免；伊方则在第六天重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，第七天重启谈判。
segments.tr: - **Plan Details**: According to the Iranian Foreign Minister, Iran has conveyed a step-by-step plan to the U.S. via Qatar—the U.S. lifts the blockade on Iranian ports and grants sanctions waivers for Iranian oil exports; in return, Iran reopens the Strait of Hormuz on the sixth day and resumes negotiations on the seventh day.

segments.src: - **美方态度**：美方表示相关讨论“积极且具建设性”，但暂时不急于公开表态。
segments.tr: - **U.S. Stance**: The U.S. stated that the discussions were "positive and constructive," but is in no rush to make a public statement for now.

segments.src: - **市场反应**：消息发酵后，国际油价应声回落约2.3%，布伦特原油期货价格降至每桶104美元附近。
segments.tr: - **Market Reaction**: Following the news, international oil prices fell by approximately 2.3%, with Brent crude futures dropping to around $104 per barrel.

segments.src: - **关键悬念**：方案能否落地，取决于双方对“先后顺序”和“互信基础”的理解能否对上。
segments.tr: - **Key Suspense**: Whether the plan can be implemented depends on whether both sides can align their understanding of the "sequence" and the "basis of mutual trust."

segments.src: ## 一、“七天方案”说了什么
从公开报道的信息看，这个方案的核心是一种“先松后开、再谈”的对等交换，大致可以拆成三步：
segments.tr: Based on publicly reported information, the core of this plan is a "relax first, open later, then talk" reciprocal exchange, which can be roughly broken down into three steps:

segments.src: | 阶段 | 美方动作 | 伊方动作 |
| 前置条件 | 解除对伊朗港口的封锁 | — |
segments.tr: | Prerequisites | Lift the blockade on Iranian ports | — |

segments.src: | 同步安排 | 对伊朗石油出口给予制裁豁免 | — |
segments.tr: | Simultaneous Arrangement | Grant sanctions waivers for Iranian oil exports | — |

segments.src: | 第6天 | — | 重新开放霍尔木兹海峡 |
segments.tr: | Day 6 | — | Reopen the Strait of Hormuz |

segments.src: | 第7天 | 重启谈判 | 重启谈判 |
需要说明的是，关于“第六天”“第七天”具体从何时起算、豁免的范围与期限如何界定、由谁来核查执行等细节，目前公开信息有限，最终版本可能与外界的初步理解存在差异。
segments.tr: It should be noted that details regarding when the "sixth day" and "seventh day" specifically begin, how the scope and duration of the waivers are defined, and who will verify implementation are currently limited in public information, and the final version may differ from initial external interpretations.

segments.src: ## 二、为什么由卡塔尔来传话
segments.tr: ## II. Why Qatar is Delivering the Message

segments.src: 在双方缺乏直接、公开沟通渠道的情况下，第三方斡旋往往是重要的缓冲带。卡塔尔在海湾地区长期扮演沟通协调的角色，与多方都保持联系，通过它转达方案，既有助于降低误判风险，也给双方留出了“先试探、再表态”的空间。
segments.tr: In the absence of direct, public communication channels between the two sides, third-party mediation often serves as an important buffer. Qatar has long played a role in communication and coordination in the Gulf region, maintaining contact with multiple parties. Conveying the plan through Qatar helps reduce the risk of misjudgment and leaves room for both sides to "test the waters before making a statement."

segments.src: 不过，斡旋渠道的存在并不等于方案一定会被接受。中间人能传递的是信息，而不是承诺。
segments.tr: However, the existence of a mediation channel does not mean the plan will necessarily be accepted. An intermediary can convey information, but not promises.

segments.src: ## 三、美方的表态透露了什么信号
segments.tr: ## III. What Signals the U.S. Stance Reveals

segments.src: 美方用“积极且具建设性”来形容相关讨论，同时并未急于对方案本身作出明确表态。这种措辞通常可以有几种解读：
segments.tr: The U.S. described the relevant discussions as "positive and constructive" while not rushing to make a definitive statement on the plan itself. This phrasing can usually be interpreted in several ways:

segments.src: 1. **保持接触的意愿**：至少说明双方沟通渠道是通的，讨论并未陷入僵局。
segments.tr: 1. **Willingness to maintain contact**: At the very least, it indicates that communication channels between the two sides are open and that discussions have not reached a stalemate.

segments.src: 2. **保留谈判空间**：不立即表态，意味着美方仍在评估方案细节，也为后续讨价还价留有余地。
segments.tr: 2. **Preserving room for negotiation**: Not making an immediate statement means the U.S. is still evaluating the details of the plan, leaving room for subsequent bargaining.

segments.src: 3. **内部评估仍在进行**：解除港口封锁与豁免石油制裁都属于重大政策调整，往往需要多个部门协调，也要考虑盟友和国内舆论的反应。
segments.tr: 3. **Internal assessment is still ongoing**: Lifting port blockades and waiving oil sanctions are both major policy adjustments that often require coordination across multiple departments and must also consider the reactions of allies and domestic public opinion.

segments.src: 因此，“积极”并不等于“接受”，市场和观察人士更应关注接下来是否出现具体的、可核实的行动。
segments.tr: Therefore, "positive" does not equal "accepted," and the market and observers should focus more on whether concrete, verifiable actions follow.

segments.src: ## 四、油价为何应声回落
segments.tr: ## IV. Why Oil Prices Fell in Response

segments.src: 霍尔木兹海峡是全球最重要的能源运输咽喉之一，据国际能源机构等机构的公开数据，全球相当比例的海运石油需要经过这里。正因如此，任何关于“通行受限”或“恢复通行”的消息，都会迅速反映到油价上。
segments.tr: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important energy transport chokepoints. According to public data from the International Energy Agency and other institutions, a significant proportion of the world's seaborne oil must pass through here. Because of this, any news regarding "restricted passage" or "restored passage" is quickly reflected in oil prices.

segments.src: 此次布伦特原油下跌约2.3%、回落至104美元附近，主要体现的是市场对**供应风险缓解**的预期：
segments.tr: The drop in Brent crude by approximately 2.3% to around $104 primarily reflects market expectations of **mitigated supply risks**:

segments.src: - 如果海峡重新开放，运输受阻带来的风险溢价有望下降；
segments.tr: - If the strait is reopened, the risk premium caused by transport disruptions is expected to decrease;

segments.src: - 如果伊朗石油出口获得豁免，市场上的可售供应量可能增加；
segments.tr: - If Iranian oil exports receive waivers, the available supply in the market may increase;

segments.src: - 但由于方案尚未获得美方确认，这种预期仍然脆弱，价格随时可能因新消息而反复。
segments.tr: - However, because the plan has not yet been confirmed by the U.S., this expectation remains fragile, and prices could fluctuate at any time due to new news.

segments.src: 换句话说，当前价格反映的是“可能性”，而不是“既成事实”。
segments.tr: In other words, the current price reflects "possibility," not a "fait accompli."

segments.src: ## 五、接下来值得关注的几个节点
segments.tr: ## V. Several Nodes Worth Watching Next

segments.src: - **美方是否给出正式回应**：是接受、修改还是拒绝，将直接决定方案的走向。
segments.tr: - **Whether the U.S. provides a formal response**: Whether it accepts, modifies, or rejects the plan will directly determine its direction.

segments.src: - **顺序之争**：双方是否愿意接受“先解封、后开放”的先后安排，还是会要求同步或分阶段推进。
segments.tr: - **The Sequence Dispute**: Whether both sides are willing to accept the "lift blockade first, open later" sequence, or whether they will demand simultaneous or phased implementation.

segments.src: - **执行与核查机制**：谁来确认封锁已解除、海峡已恢复正常通行，是避免互相指责的关键。
segments.tr: - **Implementation and Verification Mechanisms**: Who will confirm that the blockade has been lifted and that the strait has returned to normal passage is key to avoiding mutual accusations.

segments.src: - **其他相关方的态度**：海湾国家、主要能源进口国以及国际航运业的反应，也会影响方案的推进。
segments.tr: - **The Stance of Other Relevant Parties**: The reactions of Gulf countries, major energy importers, and the international shipping industry will also affect the progress of the plan.

segments.src: - **能源市场的后续走势**：包括库存数据、产油国的供应安排以及需求端的变化。
segments.tr: - **Subsequent Trends in Energy Markets**: Including inventory data, supply arrangements from oil-producing countries, and changes on the demand side.

segments.src: ## 六、编辑观察：为什么这件事不只关乎油价
segments.tr: ## VI. Editor's Observation: Why This Is Not Just About Oil Prices

segments.src: 对普通读者而言，这一事件的影响不止于加油站的价格牌。能源价格波动会通过运输成本、制造成本传导到更多领域，进而影响通胀预期和各国的经济政策判断。同时，这也提醒我们：在地缘局势复杂的背景下，**单一消息引发的价格波动往往幅度大、持续性弱**，对信息保持理性、多方比对，比追逐短期涨跌更重要。
segments.tr: For the average reader, the impact of this event goes beyond the price signs at gas stations. Fluctuations in energy prices will be transmitted to more sectors through transport costs and manufacturing costs, thereby affecting inflation expectations and economic policy judgments in various countries. At the same time, this reminds us: against the backdrop of a complex geopolitical situation, **price fluctuations triggered by a single piece of news are often large in magnitude but weak in persistence**. Staying rational about information and comparing multiple sources is more important than chasing short-term ups and downs.

segments.src: *说明：本文根据公开报道和相关表态整理，旨在提供信息参考，不构成任何投资建议。事件仍在发展中，具体细节请以官方和权威媒体的后续发布为准。*

cn-20260927-intro-retail-9.title: [Retail Science #9] Stop Saying "I'm Selling Products"—You're Actually Running Dozens of Small Businesses at Once

segments.src: > 商品管理的深水区，是把每一个品类当成一门独立的小生意：先给它定角色，再控它的库存，最后管它的价格。
segments.tr: > The deep end of merchandise management is treating each product category as an independent small business: first assign it a role, then control its inventory, and finally manage its pricing.

segments.src: ## 今天的概念
上一讲我们聊的是"三米货架上放什么"。这一讲往下挖一层：**放上去之后怎么管**。零售业把这件事拆成三块。
segments.tr: Last time we discussed "what to put on a three-meter shelf." Today we dig deeper: **how to manage what goes up there**. The retail industry breaks this into three parts.

segments.src: **第一块：品类管理（Category Management）。**
关键动作是换一个分组视角——不按供应商分，也不按仓库分，而是按**顾客怎么做购买决策**分。顾客早上想解决"早餐"这件事，他不会走到"某某乳业专柜"，他会在牛奶、酸奶、面包、包子、豆浆之间比较。那这些商品在管理上就该被放进同一个思考单元。
segments.tr: The key move is to shift your grouping perspective—not by supplier, not by warehouse, but by **how customers make purchase decisions**. When a customer wants to solve the "breakfast" problem in the morning, they won't go to "some dairy counter." Instead, they'll compare milk, yogurt, bread, buns, and soy milk. So these products should be placed in the same management unit.

segments.src: 分好组之后，要给每个品类**定角色**，因为不是所有品类都该赚一样的钱：
segments.tr: After grouping, you need to **assign a role** to each category, because not all categories should make the same profit:

segments.src: - **目标性品类**：顾客专门为它进店（生鲜、鲜奶），任务是"引客"，价格要有竞争力；
segments.tr: - **Destination categories**: products customers enter the store specifically for (fresh produce, fresh milk). Mission: "draw traffic." Pricing must be competitive;

segments.src: - **常规性品类**：日常主力（粮油、纸品），任务是"稳定出货+贡献毛利"；
segments.tr: - **Core categories**: everyday staples (grains, oils, paper products). Mission: "stable sales + profit contribution";

segments.src: - **季节性品类**：月饼、粽子、开学文具，任务是"抓时间窗"；
segments.tr: - **Seasonal categories**: mooncakes, rice dumplings, school supplies. Mission: "capture the seasonal window";

segments.src: - **便利性品类**：临时才想起来买的（电池、雨伞、创可贴），任务是"顺手补一笔高毛利"。
segments.tr: - **Convenience categories**: impulse purchases (batteries, umbrellas, bandages). Mission: "add a high-margin impulse sale."

segments.src: 角色定错，后面全错——把便利性品类当引流品去打价格战，就是白白把毛利送掉。
segments.tr: Get the role wrong and everything else goes wrong—treating convenience categories as traffic drivers and engaging in price wars is just throwing away margins.

segments.src: **第二块：库存管理。**
库存是"睡在货架上的现金"。压得太多，现金变货、货又变临期；压得太少，顾客来了买不到（缺货），这一单没了，人还可能不再来。所以零售不看"我囤了多少"，看两个指标：
segments.tr: Inventory is "cash sleeping on the shelf." Stock too much, and cash becomes merchandise, which then becomes near-expiration products; stock too little, and customers can't find what they want (out of stock), losing that sale and potentially the customer altogether. So retail doesn't look at "how much I stockpile," but two metrics:

segments.src: 库存周转率 = 销售成本 ÷ 平均库存成本
segments.tr: 库存周转率 = 销售成本 ÷ 平均库存成本

segments.src: GMROI（毛利库存回报率）= 毛利额 ÷ 平均库存成本
segments.tr: GMROI（毛利库存回报率）= 毛利额 ÷ 平均库存成本

segments.src: GMROI 的含义很直白：每投进去 1 元的库存，带回来多少毛利。它比单看毛利率更公平——毛利率 40% 但三个月才卖一轮的商品，可能不如毛利率 15% 但每周转一轮的牛奶赚钱。
segments.tr: The meaning of GMROI is straightforward: for every 1 yuan of inventory invested, how much profit does it generate? It's fairer than looking at profit margin alone—a product with a 40% margin that sells only once every three months may not be as profitable as milk with a 15% margin that turns over weekly.

segments.src: **第三块：价格政策。**
两条主流路线：**EDLP（天天低价）**，价格常年稳定、促销少，顾客不用等打折，门店的备货和人力也更好安排；**High-Low（高低价）**，平时价格偏高、靠频繁档期做刺激，热闹但波动大。
segments.tr: Two main paths: **EDLP (Everyday Low Pricing)**, with stable year-round prices and infrequent promotions, so customers don't wait for sales, and stores can better plan inventory and labor; **High-Low Pricing**, with higher everyday prices and frequent promotional events for stimulus, exciting but volatile.

segments.src: 无论走哪条路，都得先认清一件事：顾客只记得住少数商品的价格。这些商品叫 **KVI（关键价值商品）**，比如鸡蛋、大米、可乐、抽纸。KVI 定价决定了顾客对整店"贵不贵"的印象；而绝大多数不敏感的商品（冷门调味料、小家居），是用来把整体毛利拉回来的。所谓定价能力，就是这两类账的组合。
segments.tr: Regardless of which path you take, you must first understand one thing: customers only remember the prices of a small number of products. These are called **KVIs (Key Value Items)**—like eggs, rice, cola, and tissue paper. KVI pricing determines customers' perception of whether the store is "expensive or cheap"; the vast majority of non-sensitive items (obscure seasonings, small home goods) are what bring overall margins back up. The so-called pricing power is the combination of these two types of accounting.

segments.src: ## 生活中的例子
成都一个小区门口的社区超市，120 平米，老板娘王姐。
segments.tr: A neighborhood supermarket at the entrance of a residential complex in Chengdu, 120 square meters, run by a woman named Sister Wang.

segments.src: 她的酸奶货架原来摆了 22 个单品，看上去很丰富。月销售额 30,000 元，毛利率 20%，也就是月毛利 6,000 元；货架加小仓的平均库存成本约 4,000 元。
segments.tr: Her yogurt shelf originally had 22 SKUs, looking quite diverse. Monthly sales were 30,000 yuan, with a 20% profit margin, meaning monthly profit of 6,000 yuan; the average inventory cost for the shelf and small storage area was about 4,000 yuan.

segments.src: 每 1 元库存投入带回 1.5 元毛利。听着还行，但她每月还要扔掉三四百块的临期货。
segments.tr: For every 1 yuan invested in inventory, she got back 1.5 yuan in profit. That sounds decent, but she still had to throw away 300-400 yuan worth of near-expiration products every month.

segments.src: 她做了三件事：
1. **看动销**：22 个单品里，销量后 8 名合计只占酸奶销售额的 9%，还占了近三成货架和库存。砍掉 6 个，把位置让给销量前 5 名和一个新上的 8 元高端款。
segments.tr: 1. **Analyzed sales velocity**: Among the 22 SKUs, the bottom 8 sellers accounted for only 9% of yogurt sales but took up nearly 30% of the shelf and inventory. She cut 6 of them and gave the space to the top 5 sellers and a new premium 8-yuan product.

segments.src: 2. **定角色**：酸奶在她店里是"目标性品类"——很多老人早上专门下楼买。所以基础款 2 元的国民酸奶按 KVI 管，价格死守不涨，用来把人拉进门；那个 8 元高端款不承担引流任务，正常保毛利。
segments.tr: 2. **Assigned roles**: In her store, yogurt was a "destination category"—many seniors came downstairs specifically to buy it in the morning. So she managed the basic 2-yuan national yogurt brand as a KVI, kept its price steady, and used it to draw customers; the 8-yuan premium product didn't need to drive traffic, so it maintained normal margins.

segments.src: 3. **调补货**：畅销款从"三天一补"改成"一天一补"（供应商本来就每天送货，只是她嫌麻烦），单次进货量减半，安全库存留一天半的量。
segments.tr: 3. **Adjusted replenishment**: Best sellers went from "replenish every three days" to "replenish daily" (the supplier was already delivering daily; she just found it inconvenient), cut order quantities in half, and kept safety stock at one-and-a-half days' worth.

segments.src: 三个月后：月销售额 33,000 元（丰富度降了，但好卖的不缺货了），毛利率 20% 不变即毛利 6,600 元，平均库存成本降到 2,500 元。
segments.tr: Three months later: monthly sales of 33,000 yuan (variety went down, but best sellers were never out of stock), profit margin stayed at 20% yielding 6,600 yuan profit, and average inventory cost dropped to 2,500 yuan.

segments.src: 同样一片货架，投入的现金少了近四成，赚回来的毛利还多了。临期损耗也基本没了。
segments.tr: With the same shelf space, cash invested dropped nearly 40%, yet profit increased. Near-expiration losses were virtually eliminated.

segments.src: 注意她**没有涨价、没有换更贵的供应商**——只是重排了角色、库存和价格的关系。这就是"商品管理"这门课在现场的样子。
segments.tr: Notice she **didn't raise prices or switch to more expensive suppliers**—she simply reordered the relationships between roles, inventory, and pricing. That's what "merchandise management" looks like in practice.

segments.src: ## 三行总结
1. 品类管理 = 按顾客决策方式分组 + 给每个品类定角色（引流的、赚钱的、抓季节的、顺手的）。
segments.tr: 1. Category management = grouping by customer decision-making + assigning each category a role (traffic driver, profit maker, seasonal capturer, impulse seller).

segments.src: 2. 库存的核心指标不是"有多少"，而是周转率和 GMROI——每 1 元库存带回多少毛利。
segments.tr: 2. The core inventory metric isn't "how much," but turnover rate and GMROI—how much profit each 1 yuan of inventory generates.

segments.src: 3. 定价不是一刀切：KVI 塑造价格形象，非敏感品贡献毛利，EDLP 与 High-Low 是两种不同的经营节奏。
segments.tr: 3. Pricing isn't one-size-fits-all: KVIs shape price perception, non-sensitive items contribute margins, EDLP and High-Low are two different operating rhythms.

segments.src: ## ✅ 自测小问
下面哪种做法更接近"品类管理"的思路？**
segments.tr: Which of the following approaches best reflects the "category management" mindset?**

segments.src: A.
按供应商把商品分组，方便对账结算
segments.tr: Group products by supplier for easy reconciliation and settlement

segments.src: B.
按顾客的购买决策方式分组，并给每组设定不同的经营目标
segments.tr: Group by customer purchase decision-making and set different operational targets for each group

segments.src: C.
按毛利率排序，只保留高毛利商品
segments.tr: Rank by profit margin and keep only high-margin products

segments.src: D.
按上架先后顺序分组管理
segments.tr: Group and manage by shelf-stocking order

segments.src: 某店酸奶品类月毛利 6,000 元，平均库存成本 4,000 元，GMROI 约为多少？**
segments.tr: A store's yogurt category has monthly profit of 6,000 yuan and average inventory cost of 4,000 yuan. What is the GMROI approximately?**

segments.src: A.
B.
C.
D.
**3.（O / X）采用"天天低价（EDLP）"策略的门店，通常促销档期更密集、价格波动更大。**
segments.tr: **3. (True / False) Stores using "everyday low price (EDLP)" strategy typically have denser promotional periods and greater price fluctuations.**

segments.src: ## 📚 今日词条
- **品类管理（Category Management）**：把一组顾客眼中可互相替代的商品当作一个独立经营单元来管理的方法。
segments.tr: - **Category Management**: A method of managing a group of products that customers see as mutually interchangeable as an independent operating unit.

segments.src: - **品类角色**：给每个品类分配的任务定位，常见为目标性、常规性、季节性、便利性四类。
segments.tr: - **Category Role**: The mission assigned to each category, commonly classified as destination, core, seasonal, or convenience.

segments.src: - **库存周转率**：销售成本除以平均库存成本，衡量库存"转得快不快"。
segments.tr: - **Inventory Turnover Rate**: Cost of sales divided by average inventory cost, measuring how fast inventory "moves."

segments.src: - **GMROI（毛利库存回报率）**：毛利额除以平均库存成本，衡量每 1 元库存投入带回多少毛利。
segments.tr: - **GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Inventory Investment)**: Gross profit divided by average inventory cost, measuring how much profit each 1 yuan of inventory investment generates.

segments.src: - **KVI（关键价值商品）**：顾客能清楚记住价格、直接影响其"整店贵不贵"判断的少数敏感商品。
segments.tr: - **KVI (Key Value Item)**: A limited number of price-sensitive products that customers clearly remember the price of and that directly influence their perception of whether the store is "expensive or cheap."

segments.src: - **EDLP / High-Low**：两种定价路线，前者常年低价少促销，后者靠频繁档期制造价格落差。
segments.tr: - **EDLP / High-Low**: Two pricing strategies; the former uses year-round low pricing with few promotions, while the latter creates price gaps through frequent promotional periods.

segments.src: *正确答案：1 → B（品类管理的起点是顾客视角的分组，供应商分组是采购和结算的逻辑，不是经营逻辑）；2 → B（6000 ÷ 4000 = 1.5，即每 1 元库存带回 1.5 元毛利）；3 → X（频繁促销、价格起伏大的是 High-Low 高低价策略；EDLP 的特点恰恰是价格稳定、少做档期）。*
segments.tr: *Correct Answers: 1 → B (The starting point of category management is customer-perspective grouping, not supplier grouping which is for procurement and settlement); 2 → B (6,000 ÷ 4,000 = 1.5, meaning every 1 yuan of inventory generates 1.5 yuan of profit); 3 → X (Frequent promotions and price fluctuations are the High-Low strategy; EDLP is characterized by price stability and few promotional periods).*

cn-20260927-news-1.title: Comparing the U.S.-China Outcome Lists: Coal, Rare Earths, and "Superintelligence" with Differing Emphasizes

segments.src: 中国国家主席习近平结束为期三天的访美行程后，中美双方没有发布联合声明，而是各自公布了一份成果清单。两份清单都提到对等降税、人工智能领域对话等内容，但在煤炭、稀土和“超级智能”等具体表述上并不一致。本文依据公开报道，把两份清单放在一起对照，帮助读者看清哪些是双方共同点，哪些只出现在单方文本中。
segments.tr: After Chinese President Xi Jinping concluded his three-day visit to the United States, the two sides did not issue a joint statement, but instead each released a list of outcomes. Both lists mention reciprocal tariff reductions and dialogues in the field of artificial intelligence, but they differ in specific expressions regarding coal, rare earths, and "superintelligence." Based on public reports, this article puts the two lists side-by-side for comparison to help readers see clearly what points are shared and what only appears in unilateral texts.

segments.src: ## 要点速览
- 美方（白宫事实清单）写明：中国将于2027年和2028年分别进口至少1000万吨美国煤炭。
segments.tr: - The U.S. side (White House fact sheet) states: China will import at least 10 million tons of U.S. coal each in 2027 and 2028.

segments.src: - 美方清单还提到，双方将继续处理稀土及其他关键矿产供应链中的短缺问题。
segments.tr: - The U.S. list also mentions that both sides will continue to address shortages in the supply chains of rare earths and other critical minerals.

segments.src: - 美方称两国领导人同意使用“超级智能”（SI）而非“人工智能”，并设立“中美超级智能对话”，下一轮定于11月举行。
segments.tr: - The U.S. stated that the two leaders agreed to use "superintelligence" (SI) instead of "artificial intelligence" and established the "U.S.-China Superintelligence Dialogue," with the next round scheduled for November.

segments.src: - 中方清单未提及煤炭和稀土，也没有使用“超级智能”一词，表述为“人工智能”对话。
segments.tr: - The Chinese list does not mention coal or rare earths, nor does it use the term "superintelligence," describing it instead as an "artificial intelligence" dialogue.

segments.src: - 两份清单都涉及总额约300亿美元的对等降税安排，以及人工智能事件沟通渠道。
segments.tr: - Both lists involve reciprocal tariff reduction arrangements totaling about $30 billion, as well as communication channels for artificial intelligence incidents.

segments.src: - 中方清单还提到两军尽快签署危机沟通谅解备忘录、继续搜寻失踪美军人员等内容，美方清单据报道未包含这些。
segments.tr: - The Chinese list also mentions that the two militaries will sign a memorandum of understanding on crisis communication as soon as possible and continue searching for missing U.S. military personnel, which the U.S. list reportedly did not include.

segments.src: ## 一、为什么是“两份清单”
联合声明通常要经过双方逐字磋商，最终文本是双方都认可的共同表述。这次没有联合声明，各自发布的清单就成了各方向本国公众和外界说明“谈成了什么”的文本。清单不是协议全文，也不是对方确认过的表述，因此各自的措辞、排序和取舍，本身就是观察双方关注点的窗口。
segments.tr: A joint statement usually undergoes word-by-word negotiation between both sides, and the final text is a common expression approved by both. With no joint statement this time, the separately released lists became texts for each side to explain "what was achieved" to its domestic public and the outside world. A list is neither the full text of an agreement nor an expression confirmed by the other party; therefore, the respective wording, sequencing, and inclusions or omissions themselves serve as windows to observe the concerns of both sides.

segments.src: 需要强调的是：一件事没有出现在某一方清单里，并不等于该方否认或反对这件事。它可能被放在其他场合表态，也可能尚未到达可以公开的阶段。
segments.tr: It needs to be emphasized that just because a matter does not appear in one party's list does not mean that party denies or opposes it. It may have been expressed on other occasions, or it may not yet have reached a stage where it can be made public.

segments.src: ## 二、美方清单的几个关键点
segments.tr: ## II. Several Key Points of the U.S. List

segments.src: 煤炭。** 据白宫事实清单，中国将在2027年和2028年每年至少进口1000万吨美国煤炭。作为参照，中国每年的煤炭进口总量通常在数亿吨量级，1000万吨在其中占比有限。这项数字目前只见于美方表述，最终能否落地、以何种价格和合同方式执行，还要看后续的商业安排和市场情况。
segments.tr: Coal.** According to the White House fact sheet, China will import at least 10 million tons of U.S. coal annually in 2027 and 2028. For reference, China's total annual coal imports are usually on the scale of hundreds of millions of tons, making 10 million tons a limited proportion. This figure currently appears only in U.S. statements; whether it can eventually be implemented, and at what prices and contract terms, depends on subsequent commercial arrangements and market conditions.

segments.src: 稀土与关键矿产。** 美方清单提到，双方将继续就稀土和其他关键矿产供应链中的短缺问题合作，目标是让供应水平恢复到适当程度。这一条在中方清单中没有出现。
segments.tr: Rare Earths and Critical Minerals.** The U.S. list mentions that the two sides will continue to cooperate on shortages in the supply chains of rare earths and other critical minerals, with the goal of restoring supply levels to an appropriate degree. This item does not appear in the Chinese list.

segments.src: “超级智能”对话。** 美方称，两国领导人同意用“超级智能”（SI）来指代这一新兴技术，并成立“中美超级智能对话”，就相关风险与收益交换意见，同时建立处理相关事件的双边沟通渠道，下一轮对话定于11月举行。
segments.tr: "Superintelligence" Dialogue.** The U.S. stated that the leaders agreed to use "superintelligence" (SI) to refer to this emerging technology, and established the "U.S.-China Superintelligence Dialogue" to exchange views on related risks and benefits while establishing bilateral communication channels to handle related incidents, with the next round of dialogue scheduled for November.

segments.src: 关税待遇。** 双方就在各自约300亿美元的非敏感商品上给予更优惠的关税待遇达成一致。据报道，美国对华出口涉及的商品包括农产品、水产品、原木及木制品、化妆品和医疗器械等。
segments.tr: Tariff Treatment.** The two sides reached an agreement to grant more favorable tariff treatment on about $30 billion of non-sensitive goods for each other. According to reports, the goods involved in U.S. exports to China include agricultural products, aquatic products, logs and wood products, cosmetics, and medical devices, among others.

segments.src: ## 三、中方清单的侧重
segments.tr: ## III. The Focus of the Chinese List

segments.src: 据媒体梳理，中方公布的清单共八项，大致包括：
segments.tr: According to media reviews, the list published by China contains a total of eight items, roughly including:

segments.src: 1. 共同构建相互尊重、公平、对等的建设性战略稳定关系；
segments.tr: 1. Jointly building a constructive strategic stability relationship based on mutual respect, fairness, and reciprocity;

segments.src: 2. 互相支持对方主办APEC（今年11月，深圳）和G20（今年12月，美国迈阿密）；
segments.tr: 2. Mutually supporting each other in hosting APEC (November this year, Shenzhen) and the G20 (December this year, Miami, USA);

segments.src: 3. 伊朗核问题等地区议题的表态；
segments.tr: 3. Statements on regional issues such as the Iranian nuclear issue;

segments.src: 4. 回顾两国在二战中曾是盟友；
segments.tr: 4. Recalling that the two countries were allies in World War II;

segments.src: 5. 肯定双边经贸磋商成果；
segments.tr: 5. Affirming the achievements of bilateral economic and trade consultations;

segments.src: 6. 约300亿美元的对等降税安排，以及关税休战的延续；
segments.tr: 6. Reciprocal tariff reduction arrangements of about $30 billion, as well as the continuation of the tariff truce;

segments.src: 7. 中美人工智能对话：就“风险与收益”交换意见，11月举行下一轮，并建立相关事件沟通渠道；
segments.tr: 7. U.S.-China Artificial Intelligence Dialogue: exchanging views on "risks and benefits," holding the next round in November, and establishing communication channels for related incidents;

segments.src: 8. 两军就加强危机沟通与预防的谅解备忘录尽快签署，并继续开展搜寻失踪美军人员的合作。
segments.tr: 8. Signing as soon as possible a memorandum of understanding between the two militaries on strengthening crisis communication and prevention, and continuing cooperation in searching for missing U.S. military personnel.

segments.src: 可以看到，中方清单更多着墨于战略关系定位、多边场合的相互支持和军事沟通，而没有列出具体的采购数量或矿产供应事项。
segments.tr: It can be seen that the Chinese list focuses more on the positioning of strategic relations, mutual support in multilateral venues, and military communication, without listing specific procurement quantities or mineral supply matters.

segments.src: ## 五、怎么理解这些差异
segments.tr: ## V. How to Understand These Differences

segments.src: **关于措辞。** “人工智能”是通行的宽泛概念，“超级智能”一般指能力超过人类的假设性系统，讨论的风险层级更高。美方选择前者之外的说法，中方仍沿用“人工智能”，两者可能反映各自对议题的定位不同，也可能只是国内叙事习惯的差别。目前公开信息不足以判断双方在实质分歧上有多大，读者不宜过度解读单个词汇。
segments.tr: **Regarding Wording.** "Artificial Intelligence" is a common, broad concept, while "superintelligence" generally refers to hypothetical systems that exceed human capabilities, discussing a higher level of risk. The U.S. choice of terms other than the former, and China's continued use of "artificial intelligence," may reflect different positionings of the issue by each side, or simply differences in domestic narrative habits. Current public information is insufficient to judge how large the substantive differences between the two sides are, and readers should not overinterpret single vocabulary words.

segments.src: **关于具体数字。** 美方清单倾向于列出可量化的成果，例如煤炭吨数和商品品类，便于向国内产业界和选民说明；中方清单则倾向于框架性表述。这是两国官方文本风格常见的差异，并不必然意味着承诺内容不同。
segments.tr: **Regarding Specific Numbers.** The U.S. list tends to list quantifiable outcomes, such as coal tonnage and commodity categories, making it easier to explain to domestic industries and voters; the Chinese list tends toward framework-style expressions. This is a common difference in the styles of official texts of the two countries and does not necessarily mean that the commitments differ.

segments.src: **关于落地。** 无论哪份清单，都属于“意向和安排”层面。对等降税的具体商品清单、生效时间，煤炭采购的合同和价格，稀土供应的许可与流程，都需要后续的技术性文件和执行细节来确认。
segments.tr: **Regarding Implementation.** Whichever list it is, it belongs to the level of "intentions and arrangements." The specific commodity list and effective date of reciprocal tariff reductions, the contracts and prices for coal procurement, and the licenses and procedures for rare earth supplies all require subsequent technical documents and execution details to confirm.

segments.src: ## 六、接下来值得关注什么
- **11月的人工智能（超级智能）对话：** 双方会用哪个名称、讨论哪些具体议题，是检验这项机制是否走向实质的第一步。
segments.tr: - **The November Artificial Intelligence (Superintelligence) Dialogue:** Which name the two sides will use and what specific issues will be discussed are the first steps to test whether this mechanism is moving toward the substantive level.

segments.src: - **降税商品的正式名单与生效时间：** 目前公开的是品类和总额，细则决定实际影响。
segments.tr: - **The Official List and Effective Date of Tariff-Reduced Goods:** What is currently public are categories and total amounts, and the detailed rules will determine the actual impact.

segments.src: - **煤炭与稀土的后续表态：** 中方是否在其他场合就这两项作出说明，也值得留意。
segments.tr: - **Subsequent Statements on Coal and Rare Earths:** It is also worth noting whether the Chinese side makes statements on these two items in other contexts.

segments.src: - **11月的APEC深圳会议与12月的G20：** 这两个场合将提供新的沟通机会。
segments.tr: - **The APEC Shenzhen Meeting in November and the G20 in December:** These two occasions will provide new communication opportunities.

segments.src: ## 阅读提示
面对这类“各说各话”的文本，一个比较稳妥的做法是：先分清哪些是双方共同出现的内容，哪些只在单方文本中出现；对只出现在单方的内容，等待另一方或官方后续文件确认；同时区分“已公布的意向”与“已执行的措施”。
segments.tr: Facing such "talking past each other" texts, a relatively prudent approach is: first distinguish what content appears commonly from what appears only in unilateral texts; for content appearing only in unilateral texts, wait for confirmation from the other party or subsequent official documents; at the same time, differentiate between "announced intentions" and "executed measures."
